mission.title: Orison Relief: Large Fabrication Order
mission.description:
Alright,

The damage reports are still rolling in from the Nine Tails' attack on Orison and the folks at Crusader are saying they might have to repair a significant proportion of the propulsors on those platforms. That's why this one's a massive order.

Larger quantity, but same as before otherwise. Either manufacturer them yourself using an Item Fabricator or source them some other way.

When you're done, drop the propulsors off at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>. Be a big payout with this one.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."
